crossRefs.note: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
“ ‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as…
But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be…
He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the…
And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs…
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: So you also must love the foreigner, since you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: Love ye therefore the sojourner; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
